notes.title: New Hidden Shapes!!! Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951112/ca28736833668b9a9f0392c4ff11da9cbcc5c973.gif[/img]

Hey guys!!!

We have news!!!

Now you can have fun assembling the puzzles of the newest game in the Hidden series, [b]Hidden Shapes Cat Realm!![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143290/Hidden_Shapes__Cat_Realm/

In this new game in the series you will have fun following the adventure of a fearless kitten to save the princess from the clutches of a dragon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951112/38beb9079e6c3f00b5783771c7d63917c2964083.gif[/img]

Be amazed by the beautiful art and animations as you complete the puzzle, all prepared to increase the immersion of this beautiful hand-drawn game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951112/b3e7d81343d75f31b542072420f22c33be9d6efe.gif[/img]

[b]We hope you have a lot of fun with the game it is being made with great care!!![/b]

notes.title: Hidden Shapes in VR!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38975334/7f8944c61c41113301bd2261c2861ac197b538e7.png[/img]

[b]Hidden Shapes in VR!!![/b]

If you like the "Hidden Shapes" series, [b]we have great news for you![/b]

We at Yaw Studios are porting the first game in the “HS” series to VR!
Now you can play with much greater immersion giving you more fun, relaxation and stress relief!

Play games, sitting comfortably in your gaming chair or even lying down in the comfort of your own home! You can adjust the viewing angle providing greater comfort and immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38975334/5382363fc90242b5d53331de1a767cd08c8bfad1.gif[/img]

This is a big step, for us a small studio, we are learning and perfecting the game in this new technology and to start we chose “Hidden Shapes - Animals”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38975334/f9d89598e5269e2b3af4add9208a4c050d98990a.gif[/img]

We can't wait for you to feel this new relaxing experience, we've been working hard on this version and we hope you enjoy it a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063450/Hidden_Shapes_Animals__VR/

Once again we would like to thank the entire community, because without you none of this would be happening.

notes.title: Hidden Shapes - Trick or Cats Available Now!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979360/62f7e6061ee73b81e115c7077b199afc8676c8c5.gif[/img]

Hello guys!!!

[b]Hidden Shapes - Trick or Cats Arrived!![/b]

Have fun assembling the puzzles of the newest game in the Hidden Shapes series, with our new release you will have fun and [b]enjoy Halloween with our favorite kittens[/b]. There are several stages for you to enjoy, [b]with beautiful animated art[/b] and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979360/b73649076fc3441e7e679c54d00e7ad64678b9c7.gif[/img]

Surprise yourself as you complete the puzzle, beautiful and fun animations for you to admire and enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979360/9a38b096af7a07d7990f7b859b2375d7700e3cbf.gif[/img]

Again we would like to count on the support of the community to make this game a great success! To facilitate communication in addition to the forum here on Steam we have our [b]OFFICIAL DISCORD[/b], and social networks, there you can share all your ideas and feedback about the game and you will know in advance all the news.
